title: User receives HTTP 403 after successful login
symptom: The user enters valid credentials, login succeeds, but the portal returns HTTP 403 Forbidden when opening the dashboard.
user_impact: One user can authenticate but cannot access the Customer Portal dashboard. Business impact is limited until role or group scope is confirmed.
recent_changes: Application role mapping was updated in the sample environment earlier that morning.

evidence.detail: User reports valid credentials are accepted, then the dashboard returns HTTP 403 Forbidden.
HTTP 403 observed on /dashboard after successful login and redirect.
Sample log references correlation ID sample-corr-20260707-104500-def456 and authorization denied while checking dashboard permission.
Authentication appears successful; application authorization still needs role, group, or claim validation.

operator_notes: Treat this as an access-control investigation. Do not add permissions until the expected access model is confirmed.
